meta_description:
123 likes, 13 comments - gizmodo on October 30, 2026: "The New World screwworm (Cochliomyia hominivorax) is spreading further across the United States and finding new kinds of hosts to burrow itself into.
Several new cases of infestations caused by the parasitic fly have been reported this past week, including the first ever documented in Arizona since the screwworm reemerged in the country earlier this year. New Mexico officials also recently reported the first U.S. case found in a pet cat. October has seen a sizeable increase in reports of the screwworm affecting both domestic and wild animals.

Read more at the link in bio

Story: Ed Cara".
